title: James Allen death with heavy metals

tellings.quote: But then, uh, James Allen, the creator of the movie about Mark McCandish, uh, Zero Point or whatever, he died of an aggressive form of cancer and they found heavy metals in his autopsy.
James Allen, the documentary of Mark McCandish and the Flex Liner story, he was diagnosed and dead of an aggressive form of cancer in about 3 weeks.
tellings.difference: Says he died within about three weeks of diagnosis and does not mention heavy metals at autopsy.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the death from aggressive cancer of James Allen, maker of the Mark McCandlish documentary.

as_told.title: Death of James Allen, the McCandlish documentarian

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of a filmmaker named James Allen, who made a movie about a man named Mark McCandlish, a film Michels thinks was called something like Zero Point. Michels says Allen died of an aggressive cancer and that heavy metals were found in his body at autopsy. He raises it as a death some find suspicious, as if it might be linked to the subject of the film.
